name: Design
description: Um canvas de pranchetas ao lado da sessão: o Claude escreve HTML com o Tailwind do projeto e o plugin mostra cada prancheta renderizada, no claro e no escuro.
author: Arthur Fonseca

tools.name: design_open
tools.description: Open (or create) a design canvas beside this session and get the folder layout, board list and the writing guide. Call it first, once per session. Pass `canvas` for an existing/explicit folder, or `name` to create <company>/design/<name> next to the repo.

canvas.description: Canvas folder (absolute, ~/ or relative to the session cwd). Omit to use the canvas last opened in this session.

name.description: New canvas name when no folder is given: lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

tools.name: design_board
tools.description: Create or update a board entry (size and position) and get its .html path. Then write the HTML with Write/Edit (this tool never writes content) and call design_render. Same name again updates the entry.

name.description: Board name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (becomes boards/<name>.html).

h.description: Height in CSS px. Omit to follow the content.

x.description: Canvas x. Omit for a free spot.

y.description: Canvas y. Omit for a free spot.

canvas.description: Canvas folder (absolute, ~/ or relative to the session cwd). Omit to use the canvas last opened in this session.

tools.name: design_render
tools.description: Render boards now and return their light/dark PNGs plus errors. Call it after every round of Write/Edit and look at both themes before telling the user a board is done. Max 4 boards (8 images) per call; omit `boards` for all.

boards.description: Board names. Omit for every board.

theme.description: Which images to return. Default both.

canvas.description: Canvas folder (absolute, ~/ or relative to the session cwd). Omit to use the canvas last opened in this session.

tools.name: design_focus
tools.description: Scroll and zoom the user's canvas to a board.

board.description: Board name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (becomes boards/<name>.html).

canvas.description: Canvas folder (absolute, ~/ or relative to the session cwd). Omit to use the canvas last opened in this session.

tools.name: design_list
tools.description: List boards (path, size, components used) and components (path, boards that use them) of a canvas.

canvas.description: Canvas folder (absolute, ~/ or relative to the session cwd). Omit to use the canvas last opened in this session.
